name: Ulm and Braun functionalism
summary: Systematic household products of the Ulm school and the Braun firm: grey and white cases of aluminium and plastic, built on a grid, with controls that explain the object.

philosophy.core_thesis: A product is a system: it is as little design as possible, it explains its use, and it fits with its neighbours on a common grid.
design_principles: Build each product on a grid; set all parts to a module of 5 or 10 mm.
Make the case a plain box with radius 1 to 4 mm, in white, grey or black.
Put the controls in a clear group, and mark each with a small, grey or white symbol.
Use aluminium, steel or matte plastic; no surface has a decorative texture.
Keep colour for one function only: a green, red or yellow key or a mark.
Make each object part of a family that shares size, grid and colour.
Draw for long use: choose a form that stays right after 10 years.
Test the object for use, noise and repair before the form is final.
anti_patterns: Yearly changes of form that follow fashion
Round, soft pod forms and bubble shapes
Hidden screws that make repair hard

form.geometry: The rectangular box, the cylinder and the flat plane on a square grid; each edge lines up with the next.
form.silhouette: A flat, rectangular block with one clear front; a row of dials and keys inside a grid.
form.edges: A small radius of 1 to 4 mm on a plastic case; a sharp, clean arris on aluminium.
form.proportion: A shelf module is 36 cm wide and 22 or 32 cm deep; a radio body is about 4 times as wide as it is high.
form.ornament: None. The only decoration is the function: a printed scale, a dial ring or a key row.
rules: Every part is placed on a grid of 5 or 10 mm.
The case is a box or a cylinder with a radius of 1 to 4 mm.
The body has one main colour: white, light grey, or black.
Each key or dial has one job and one mark.
A colour accent covers less than 5% of the front.

materials.rule: Plastic and metal make about 80% of the visible surface; wood is a small, plain part in a natural colour.

finish.gloss: 5–20 GU on plastic and paint; 40–70 GU on brushed metal
finish.patina: The style wants a clean, even surface; the object gets old with no mark, and a worn knob or a scratch counts as a fault.

hardware.section: Rails and rods 8–20 mm; keys and dials of 10–30 mm diameter
hardware.joints: Screws and clips in a regular row; the case opens for repair and the fixings are visible.
hardware.handles: A recessed finger grip, a flat bar or a ribbed dial of black plastic.
hardware.switches_and_taps: A square rocker switch in white plastic; a rotary dial with a white dot and a grey scale.

palette.strategy: Grey and white as the ground, black for the controls, and one function colour at most: yellow, green or red.

processes: press forming and anodising of aluminium
screen printing of scales and marks
manufacture.scale: Series of tens of thousands of units from one electrical products firm, with parts shared across a product family.
manufacture.signs: A flush front plate, a printed scale, a ribbed black dial, a joint line at 1 mm and a clip-on grille with fine slots.

objects.form: straight rail on two square brackets
square rocker plate in white plastic
adjustable arm with a cylinder head
wall rails and shelves on a grid system
box stool and table in plywood
flat cylinder body with a black handle
wall clock with a flat case and a printed dial

positive: Braun and Ulm school product design

emotion.target_response: Calm confidence: the object is clear, exact and easy to use, and it does not ask for attention.

use_cases: product briefs in the style of a design-led electronics firm
a clean, grey and white object set for a modernist flat
a still life of shelf, radio, clock and lamp
avoid_when: The brief asks for warmth, a hand finish or natural fibre.
The brief asks for curves, colour or fun.

modifiers.how: Swap plastic and aluminium for oiled teak and birch, and use wool and linen for the soft parts.
Use moulded pods, round forms and saturated colour on whole bodies.
Keep the plain form and the grid, but drop the function colour and use a soft, matte grey.

ornament_level.note: Only a printed scale or a dial ring is allowed.

era_blend.note: A contemporary object may keep the grid and the plain case.
